articleTitle: A method of synthesis and the electrical characteristics of two-resonator quasipolynomial bandstop filters with the lumped elements
publicationTitle: 4th IEEE-Russia Conference Microwave Electronics: Measurements, Identification, Applications, 2003. MEMIA 2003. Proceedings of the
abstract: In this paper the technique of calculation of quasipolynomials for two resonator bandstop filters (BSFs) with the lumped elements is offered and their characteristics in the frequency band and in the range of tuning are considered. The capability of the construction of two resonator BSF with the lumped elements, which have the satisfactory electrical characteristics in the range of tuning, is shown.

articleTitle: MW electromagnetic field distribution in biological tissue under slot irradiator treatment
publicationTitle: 4th IEEE-Russia Conference Microwave Electronics: Measurements, Identification, Applications, 2003. MEMIA 2003. Proceedings of the
abstract: The electromagnetic field distributions calculated and obtained in the experiments on biological tissues are analyzed. A close agreement between calculated and experimental data is observed. It is shown that in the direction normal to the slot irradiator the electric filed spreads far beyond the slot and in the direction along the slot the field is concentrated near the center of the slot and does not spread beyond the boundaries of the slot.

articleTitle: Description of disorder in polycrystal
publicationTitle: 4th IEEE-Russia Conference Microwave Electronics: Measurements, Identification, Applications, 2003. MEMIA 2003. Proceedings of the
abstract: A model for the mathematical description of disorder in polycrystal is proposed in this work. In the suggested framework the interference expression of function required for conductivity derivation is obtained.

articleTitle: A new parameter extraction approach for the circuit-based models of FETs
publicationTitle: 4th IEEE-Russia Conference Microwave Electronics: Measurements, Identification, Applications, 2003. MEMIA 2003. Proceedings of the
abstract: A new parameter extraction approach for identification of FET in the class of circuit-based models is proposed. The computational (and simulation) part of this procedure use analytical smoothing of the experimental data (measured S-parameters). Except smoothing and analytical expressions for calculation of parameters it gives the solution of poorly conditional problem of adequate use of this class of circuit-based models. The elements of FET model are extracted by Eagleware Genesys simulator with the developed optimization procedure.

articleTitle: Simulation of electromagnetic processes in microwave film resistors
publicationTitle: 4th IEEE-Russia Conference Microwave Electronics: Measurements, Identification, Applications, 2003. MEMIA 2003. Proceedings of the
abstract: This work presents the mathematical model for description of electromagnetic processes in a resistive film permitting to calculate the frequency characteristics of the input impedance and transfer factor of microwave planar resistors on the basis of an equivalent circuit, obtained through the method of the current bars.

articleTitle: Synthesis of the harmonic noise compensator
publicationTitle: 4th IEEE-Russia Conference Microwave Electronics: Measurements, Identification, Applications, 2003. MEMIA 2003. Proceedings of the
abstract: The method of compensation of harmonic noise at the input of the receiver is suggested. The main technical characteristics of the proposed method have been found.

articleTitle: The microwave flowmeter for fine-grained media control
publicationTitle: 4th IEEE-Russia Conference Microwave Electronics: Measurements, Identification, Applications, 2003. MEMIA 2003. Proceedings of the
abstract: The new model of the microwave flowmeter is described in this paper. The control method is based on the direct electromagnetical field excitation in a pipeline with a help of slots. The estimation of the scattered and incident field amplitude is presented, the amplitude of the former is an informative parameter depending on the coal dust concentration. The advantages and disadvantages of classic Doppler sensors are considered.

articleTitle: On ensuring the unity of measurement of the active UHF chain S-parameters
publicationTitle: 4th IEEE-Russia Conference Microwave Electronics: Measurements, Identification, Applications, 2003. MEMIA 2003. Proceedings of the
abstract: In this work the coaxial contact device (CCD) and the method of its calibration are described. The information on S-parameters measured in the coaxial tract system is supposed to be useful for the same measurements (MS) in the microwave tract. It can be used in the composition. MS technological checking systems (TCS) and in the computer aided design (CAD).

articleTitle: Errors of measurement in line characteristic simulation
publicationTitle: 4th IEEE-Russia Conference Microwave Electronics: Measurements, Identification, Applications, 2003. MEMIA 2003. Proceedings of the
abstract: The errors of measurement of line characteristic exponent line caused by final duration of front of step function and the complex additive to spectra of entrance and target signals was determined by method of modulation on the computer.

articleTitle: Dependence of variation of average frequencies of diffusion type transducers on deviation of diffusion temperature
publicationTitle: 4th IEEE-Russia Conference Microwave Electronics: Measurements, Identification, Applications, 2003. MEMIA 2003. Proceedings of the
abstract: The effect of temperature change in one stage diffusion of acceptor impurity in low resistive semiconductor crystals of cadmium sulfide on average frequency of diffusion type transducers is considered. The expression for analysis of the phenomenon is derived from the second equation of diffusion. Some practical considerations for increase of reproducibility of diffusion type transducer parameters are presented.

articleTitle: Macroscopic averaging of electrical properties inside grains of polycrystalline materials
publicationTitle: 4th IEEE-Russia Conference Microwave Electronics: Measurements, Identification, Applications, 2003. MEMIA 2003. Proceedings of the
abstract: The polycrystalline material film consists of various size crystalline grains that have properties of crystalline material. The grains are usually randomly spatially oriented thus affecting the magnitude of orientation dependent properties. Here we considered resistive and piezoresistive properties of polycrystalline silicon. Depending on the dopant concentration within the grains the depleted regions originated owing to carrier trapping on the grain boundary can have various lengths. As the carrier concentration within depletion region is lower the resistance and piezoresistance can be higher than in the rest of the grain. Results of the calculation show that the deviation of the average parameters such as concentration of free carriers, specific resistivity, piezoresistance coefficient, can be significantly different from that obtained on assumption of uniform free carrier distribution in the crystallite.

articleTitle: Theory of the high-power tetrode amplifiers
publicationTitle: 4th IEEE-Russia Conference Microwave Electronics: Measurements, Identification, Applications, 2003. MEMIA 2003. Proceedings of the
abstract: The paper is devoted to the mathematical modeling of the nonlinear circuits and the high-power electron devices with grids. The author obtained models on the unified grounds. Such models can find applications in synthesis of power amplifiers, in optimization of the work mode, and in the determination of the efficiency limit values.

articleTitle: Fundamentals of the transport network functions
publicationTitle: 4th IEEE-Russia Conference Microwave Electronics: Measurements, Identification, Applications, 2003. MEMIA 2003. Proceedings of the
abstract: In the 21st century the mankind entered a new era called the era of global information society (GIS). The distinct feature of GIS is that knowledge and information become the most important factors of production, form the material basis for the society existence. The new sectors appear specializing in using high technologies, which are primarily presented by the creation of information products (including software) and their effective distribution within the infocommunication environment. To ensure the effective transmission and distribution of information, the structure of GIS includes Worldwide Communication Network, which is an aggregate of all mutually connected national communication networks of the world, and it is still developing. The technical basis for any modern communication network is provided by the information transport networks intended for high-quality and faultless (uninterrupted) transmission of information in the form of standard or normalized data streams from the sender to the recipient.

articleTitle: An analysis of efficiency of the modified Kalman's filter of the second order
publicationTitle: 4th IEEE-Russia Conference Microwave Electronics: Measurements, Identification, Applications, 2003. MEMIA 2003. Proceedings of the
abstract: The convergence compensator of the second order using echo-signal property of relativity is investigated. The main technical characteristics which surpass those of the well-known-echo compensators are analyzed.

articleTitle: The simulation of an adaptive algorithm of the discrete message transmissions with detection of channel state within the fixed observation time period
publicationTitle: 4th IEEE-Russia Conference Microwave Electronics: Measurements, Identification, Applications, 2003. MEMIA 2003. Proceedings of the
abstract: For the communications channel with the two states ("good" and "bad"), we examine the simulation model of the communications channel state detection adaptive algorithm with a fixed period of observation.

articleTitle: Setup for test operation of the frictional material UHF heating
publicationTitle: 4th IEEE-Russia Conference Microwave Electronics: Measurements, Identification, Applications, 2003. MEMIA 2003. Proceedings of the
abstract: The application of ultrahigh frequency for heating the friction material is considered in this paper.

articleTitle: Translation, scale and rotation invariant object recognition
publicationTitle: 4th IEEE-Russia Conference Microwave Electronics: Measurements, Identification, Applications, 2003. MEMIA 2003. Proceedings of the
abstract: Over the last years the problem of pattern recognition under various geometrical transformations is very important. In the case of affection scale and rotation transforms, well-known correlation-extreme algorithms are not efficient. The invariant object recognition methods of translation, scale and rotation are suggested. Root-mean-square method is more computationally expensive, but it provides good recognition when alien objects have different shape with object size error up to 25%.

articleTitle: Increasing efficiency of systems automated design and technological checking transistor UHF device
publicationTitle: 4th IEEE-Russia Conference Microwave Electronics: Measurements, Identification, Applications, 2003. MEMIA 2003. Proceedings of the
abstract: Considered possibility of raising efficiency of systems of computer-aided design UHF devices and systems of technological checking of their active components on base of exact and identical using S parameters of these components and their volt-ampere features.

articleTitle: The account model of amplification of the microchannel plate with deformed channel
publicationTitle: 4th IEEE-Russia Conference Microwave Electronics: Measurements, Identification, Applications, 2003. MEMIA 2003. Proceedings of the
abstract: The model of account of amplification of the MCP deformed channel is created. It is shown, that the average amplification in the channel decreases with increase of channel deformation and voltage in it.

articleTitle: Broadband matching of complex loads on the basis of theory of coupled circuits
publicationTitle: 4th IEEE-Russia Conference Microwave Electronics: Measurements, Identification, Applications, 2003. MEMIA 2003. Proceedings of the
abstract: The method of the solution of a problem of the broadband matching of complex loads with electric equivalents of the first sort is offered on the basis of the theory of oscillatory circuits. Expressions for estimation of potential opportunities of matching of complex loadings with one, two and three section polynomial and optimal MC with Chebyshev and maximally flat characteristics of working attenuation are received. The technique is offered and expressions for parameters of elements of some MC structures mentioned above are developed. All relationships may be used at manual calculations during development of the radio-electronic equipment and are especially convenient at their use in computer design procedures.

articleTitle: High-power microwave semiconductor commutator
publicationTitle: 4th IEEE-Russia Conference Microwave Electronics: Measurements, Identification, Applications, 2003. MEMIA 2003. Proceedings of the
abstract: In this work the method of synthesis of the high-power microwave semiconductor commutator is considered. By means of the commutator, the iterative procedure considering the dissipative losses in the matching elements and in semiconductor diodes is developed. The offered method of synthesis ensures a minimum magnitude of direct losses in a wide band of frequencies at high quality of the matching.

articleTitle: Very high frequency modulators of millimetric-wave band with control of a laser radiation
publicationTitle: 4th IEEE-Russia Conference Microwave Electronics: Measurements, Identification, Applications, 2003. MEMIA 2003. Proceedings of the
abstract: This paper shows a developing direction of designing of very high frequency modulators, in which one the control implements the laser. The requirements to radiooptical materials conversing modulation of a ultramicrowaves are determined. The principles of usage of interplay of optical radiation with matter are reviewed.

articleTitle: The management of quality of service in 3G mobile communications systems
publicationTitle: 4th IEEE-Russia Conference Microwave Electronics: Measurements, Identification, Applications, 2003. MEMIA 2003. Proceedings of the
abstract: In this tutorial the quality of service (QoS) of the Universal Mobile Telecommunications System (UMTS) networks is observed.

articleTitle: The compact microwave filters
publicationTitle: 4th IEEE-Russia Conference Microwave Electronics: Measurements, Identification, Applications, 2003. MEMIA 2003. Proceedings of the
abstract: In this paper, the latest achievements in the theory and practice of compact microwave filter design have been stated. The material is addressed to engineers, this may be useful for post-graduates and senior courses students of radioengineering specialty.

articleTitle: Research of the process of convergence in modified Kalman's filters of the first order
publicationTitle: 4th IEEE-Russia Conference Microwave Electronics: Measurements, Identification, Applications, 2003. MEMIA 2003. Proceedings of the
abstract: The problem of preventing the electrical echo in modern connection systems is very important nowadays. The adaptive structures of echo-compensators are based on the well-known algorithms of Kalman and Winer-Hopf. In the given article the modification of Kalman's structure based on the relative compensational method that can improve its qualitative measures is introduced.

publicationTitle: 4th IEEE-Russia Conference Microwave Electronics: Measurements, Identification, Applications, 2003. MEMIA 2003. Proceedings of the
abstract: This work describes the principles and use of GPRS. The main problems of transition towards the UMTS are also stated.
